# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1305
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1305
- **Title**: gh-1303 [CI] Pages 'Build landing + web demo' red on main — '41 packages have newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints' (blocks publish + merge-trigger)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1303` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +211
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1305
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1305
- **Title**: gh-1303 [CI] Pages 'Build landing + web demo' red on main — '41 packages have newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints' (blocks publish + merge-trigger)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1303` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +211
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

  keyed by `Podfile.lock`. The gate proves FFI exports ONLY — a Dart boot

  (issue #544: build 160, boot refactor created the platform env before
  `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized`); boot stage order is pinned by
  `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart`.
- Lockfile policy (gh-1296 NG1): EVERY lockfile is committed and enforced —
  one inventory list in `scripts/check_lockfiles.sh` (7 files:
  `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `ios/Podfile.lock`, `macos/Podfile.lock`,
  the vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` `Package.resolved`, both e2e
  `package-lock.json`s, and `vendor/wasm_run/native/Cargo.lock`); a listed
  lockfile that is missing/untracked/gitignored fails the Static gates, and
  pod-sync (flutter-analyze + nightly build legs, after `pub get`) fails
  when a native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by pubspec.lock has no pod in the
  platform's `Podfile.lock` (the gh-1274 class), or its pod is pinned at a
  stale version vs the resolved plugin podspec's `s.version` (the
  flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew; the podspec is the comparison target,
  not the pubspec version — vendored/beta pods legitimately differ from the
  Dart package version). The inventory also enforces the gh-1303 path-pin
  sync: `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pins this repo as a path dependency, so
  its `flutter_agent_harness` version must equal the root `pubspec.yaml`
  version or every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` consumer reds —
  the release bump re-pins the lock itself (`scripts/auto_release.sh`
  ships the re-pin inside the `chore(release):` commit), and the Static
  gate catches any other path to the drift at PR time. After ANY pubspec.yaml
  dependency change that adds/updates a darwin-native plugin: `cd
  flutter_app/ios && pod install --repo-update` and the same in `macos/`,
  commit both `Podfile.lock`s (CocoaPods runs fine on Linux for
  regeneration; the wasm_run `nm` step needs an llvm-nm shim + the
  XCFramework staged via `scripts/setup_vendor_ios.sh` or the upstream zip).
  Guard red exits are fixture-self-tested (`scripts/
  check_lockfiles_selftest.sh`, Static gates).
- TestFlight external distribution (issue #239): the `submit_only` lanes
  (driven by build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml) distribute every build
  straight to the EXTERNAL group — REQUIRED repo variables
  `TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP`, `BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL`,
  `BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE`, `BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL` (lanes fail loudly
  at start without them). Pilot must WAIT for processing (skipping the wait
  silently skips distribution); `verify_external_distribution!` asserts
  group membership bounded — beta-review-pending is a neutral notice, a
  build never reaching the group fails the leg (self-filed issue).
- Manual App Store review: `release-appstore.yml` (workflow_dispatch:
  `version` + `platforms` ios/macos/both + `confirm` repeating the version)
  runs the `submit_for_review` lanes — pure pre-flight in
  `flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb` (plain-ruby tested) fails
  BEFORE any mutation; already-submitted versions are a green no-op;
  release-after-approval stays a manual ASC click
  (`APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE` repo variable flips it, E5). Grep-guards:
  `test/store_automation_guard_test.dart`.
- App Store content pipeline (no binary): store screenshots are COMMITTED

# workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): the App is the ruleset
          # bypass actor, so scope the token to what the push needs instead
          # of every permission the installation carries.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # App token (not GITHUB_TOKEN) so the pushed commit triggers the
          # follow-up ci.yml run whose release-tag job cuts the tag —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          # Dry-run dispatch: the mint above is skipped, its outputs are
          # empty (falsy) and checkout falls back to the plain GITHUB_TOKEN
          # (read-only per the job permissions block).
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      # (the lockfile pins the parent path package version, so every bump
      # invalidates it) and refuses to ship while any inventory lockfile is
      # dirty — both need flutter on PATH. This job AUTHORS the lockfile for
      # every future release, so its SDK is pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming (--enforce-lockfile) build legs pin (PR #1304 rework
      # thread 8 — closes the author/consumer SDK drift class).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Bump version, changelog, push to main

          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}

  `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized`); boot stage order is pinned by
  `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart`.
- Lockfile policy (gh-1296 NG1): EVERY lockfile is committed and enforced —
  one inventory list in `scripts/check_lockfiles.sh` (7 files:
  `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `ios/Podfile.lock`, `macos/Podfile.lock`,
  the vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` `Package.resolved`, both e2e
  `package-lock.json`s, and `vendor/wasm_run/native/Cargo.lock`); a listed
  lockfile that is missing/untracked/gitignored fails the Static gates, and
  pod-sync (flutter-analyze + nightly build legs, after `pub get`) fails
  when a native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by pubspec.lock has no pod in the
  platform's `Podfile.lock` (the gh-1274 class), or its pod is pinned at a
  stale version vs the resolved plugin podspec's `s.version` (the
  flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew; the podspec is the comparison target,
  not the pubspec version — vendored/beta pods legitimately differ from the
  Dart package version). The inventory also enforces the gh-1303 path-pin
  sync: `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pins this repo as a path dependency, so
  its `flutter_agent_harness` version must equal the root `pubspec.yaml`
  version or every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` consumer reds —
  the release bump re-pins the lock itself (`scripts/auto_release.sh`
  ships the re-pin inside the `chore(release):` commit), and the Static
  gate catches any other path to the drift at PR time. After ANY pubspec.yaml
  dependency change that adds/updates a darwin-native plugin: `cd
  flutter_app/ios && pod install --repo-update` and the same in `macos/`,
  commit both `Podfile.lock`s (CocoaPods runs fine on Linux for
  regeneration; the wasm_run `nm` step needs an llvm-nm shim + the
  XCFramework staged via `scripts/setup_vendor_ios.sh` or the upstream zip).
  Guard red exits are fixture-self-tested (`scripts/
  check_lockfiles_selftest.sh`, Static gates).
- TestFlight external distribution (issue #239): the `submit_only` lanes
  (driven by build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml) distribute every build
  straight to the EXTERNAL group — REQUIRED repo variables
  `TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP`, `BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL`,
  `BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE`, `BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL` (lanes fail loudly
  at start without them). Pilot must WAIT for processing (skipping the wait
  silently skips distribution); `verify_external_distribution!` asserts
  group membership bounded — beta-review-pending is a neutral notice, a
  build never reaching the group fails the leg (self-filed issue).
- Manual App Store review: `release-appstore.yml` (workflow_dispatch:
  `version` + `platforms` ios/macos/both + `confirm` repeating the version)
  runs the `submit_for_review` lanes — pure pre-flight in
  `flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb` (plain-ruby tested) fails
  BEFORE any mutation; already-submitted versions are a green no-op;
  release-after-approval stays a manual ASC click

  `test/store_automation_guard_test.dart`.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1305
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1305
- **Title**: gh-1303 [CI] Pages 'Build landing + web demo' red on main — '41 packages have newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints' (blocks publish + merge-trigger)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1303` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +211
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1303` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Additions**: +211
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

    body = rest[: head.start()] if head else rest

# workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): the App is the ruleset
          # bypass actor, so scope the token to what the push needs instead
          # of every permission the installation carries.
          permissions: contents:write

          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1305
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1305
- **Title**: gh-1303 [CI] Pages 'Build landing + web demo' red on main — '41 packages have newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints' (blocks publish + merge-trigger)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1303` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +211
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

# workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

# workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): the App is the ruleset
          # bypass actor, so scope the token to what the push needs instead
          # of every permission the installation carries.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # App token (not GITHUB_TOKEN) so the pushed commit triggers the
          # follow-up ci.yml run whose release-tag job cuts the tag —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          # Dry-run dispatch: the mint above is skipped, its outputs are
          # empty (falsy) and checkout falls back to the plain GITHUB_TOKEN
          # (read-only per the job permissions block).
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      # gh-1299 NG1: the bump regenerates flutter_app/pubspec.lock in-commit
      # (the lockfile pins the parent path package version, so every bump
      # invalidates it) and refuses to ship while any inventory lockfile is
      # dirty — both need flutter on PATH. This job AUTHORS the lockfile for
      # every future release, so its SDK is pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming (--enforce-lockfile) build legs pin (PR #1304 rework
      # thread 8 — closes the author/consumer SDK drift class).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Bump version, changelog, push to main
        env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: bash scripts/auto_release.sh

`_wire_compile_wasm` — Podfiles force-load + `-exported_symbol` +
  `STRIP_STYLE=non-global`, else white screen on TestFlight). Pods cached
  keyed by `Podfile.lock`. The gate proves FFI exports ONLY — a Dart boot
  crash before the first frame white-screens TestFlight with a green gate
  (issue #544: build 160, boot refactor created the platform env before
  `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized`); boot stage order is pinned by
  `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart`.
- Lockfile policy (gh-1296 NG1): EVERY lockfile is committed and enforced —
  one inventory list in `scripts/check_lockfiles.sh` (7 files:
  `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `ios/Podfile.lock`, `macos/Podfile.lock`,
  the vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` `Package.resolved`, both e2e
  `package-lock.json`s, and `vendor/wasm_run/native/Cargo.lock`); a listed
  lockfile that is missing/untracked/gitignored fails the Static gates, and
  pod-sync (flutter-analyze + nightly build legs, after `pub get`) fails
  when a native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by pubspec.lock has no pod in the
  platform's `Podfile.lock` (the gh-1274 class), or its pod is pinned at a
  stale version vs the resolved plugin podspec's `s.version` (the
  flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew; the podspec is the comparison target,
  not the pubspec version — vendored/beta pods legitimately differ from the
  Dart package version). The inventory also enforces the gh-1303 path-pin
  sync: `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pins this repo as a path dependency, so
  its `flutter_agent_harness` version must equal the root `pubspec.yaml`
  version or every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` consumer reds —
  the release bump re-pins the lock itself (`scripts/auto_release.sh`
  ships the re-pin inside the `chore(release):` commit), and the Static
  gate catches any other path to the drift at PR time. After ANY pubspec.yaml
  dependency change that adds/updates a darwin-native plugin: `cd
  flutter_app/ios && pod install --repo-update` and the same in `macos/`,
  commit both `Podfile.lock`s (CocoaPods runs fine on Linux for
  regeneration; the wasm_run `nm` step needs an llvm-nm shim + the
  XCFramework staged via `scripts/setup_vendor_ios.sh` or the upstream zip).
  Guard red exits are fixture-self-tested (`scripts/
  check_lockfiles_selftest.sh`, Static gates).
- TestFlight external distribution (issue #239): the `submit_only` lanes
  (driven by build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml) distribute every build
  straight to the EXTERNAL group — REQUIRED repo variables
  `TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP`, `BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL`,
  `BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE`, `BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL` (lanes fail loudly
  at start without them). Pilot must WAIT for processing (skipping the wait
  silently skips distribution); `verify_external_distribution!` asserts
  group membership bounded — beta-review-pending is a neutral notice, a
  build never reaching the group fails the leg (self-filed issue).
- Manual App Store review: `release-appstore.yml` (workflow_dispatch:
  `version` + `platforms` ios/macos/both + `confirm` repeating the version)
  runs the `submit_for_review` lanes — pure pre-flight in
  `flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb` (plain-ruby tested) fails
  BEFORE any mutation; already-submitted versions are a green no-op;
  release-after-approval stays a manual ASC click
  (`APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE` repo variable flips it, E5). Grep-guards:
  `test/store_automation_guard_test.dart`.
- App Store content pipeline (no binary): store screenshots are COMMITTED

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1305
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1305
- **Title**: gh-1303 [CI] Pages 'Build landing + web demo' red on main — '41 packages have newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints' (blocks publish + merge-trigger)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1303` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +211
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

# workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): the App is the ruleset
          # bypass actor, so scope the token to what the push needs instead
          # of every permission the installation carries.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # App token (not GITHUB_TOKEN) so the pushed commit triggers the
          # follow-up ci.yml run whose release-tag job cuts the tag —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          # Dry-run dispatch: the mint above is skipped, its outputs are
          # empty (falsy) and checkout falls back to the plain GITHUB_TOKEN
          # (read-only per the job permissions block).
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      # gh-1299 NG1: the bump regenerates flutter_app/pubspec.lock in-commit
      # (the lockfile pins the parent path package version, so every bump
      # invalidates it) and refuses to ship while any inventory lockfile is
      # dirty — both need flutter on PATH. This job AUTHORS the lockfile for
      # every future release, so its SDK is pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming (--enforce-lockfile) build legs pin (PR #1304 rework
      # thread 8 — closes the author/consumer SDK drift class).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Bump version, changelog, push to main
        env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: bash scripts/auto_release.sh

  one inventory list in `scripts/check_lockfiles.sh` (7 files:
  `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `ios/Podfile.lock`, `macos/Podfile.lock`,
  the vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` `Package.resolved`, both e2e
  `package-lock.json`s, and `vendor/wasm_run/native/Cargo.lock`); a listed

  pod-sync (flutter-analyze + nightly build legs, after `pub get`) fails
  when a native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by pubspec.lock has no pod in the
  platform's `Podfile.lock` (the gh-1274 class), or its pod is pinned at a
  stale version vs the resolved plugin podspec's `s.version` (the
  flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew; the podspec is the comparison target,
  not the pubspec version — vendored/beta pods legitimately differ from the
  Dart package version). The inventory also enforces the gh-1303 path-pin
  sync: `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pins this repo as a path dependency, so
  its `flutter_agent_harness` version must equal the root `pubspec.yaml`
  version or every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` consumer reds —
  the release bump re-pins the lock itself (`scripts/auto_release.sh`
  ships the re-pin inside the `chore(release):` commit), and the Static
  gate catches any other path to the drift at PR time. After ANY pubspec.yaml
  dependency change that adds/updates a darwin-native plugin: `cd
  flutter_app/ios && pod install --repo-update` and the same in `macos/`,
  commit both `Podfile.lock`s (CocoaPods runs fine on Linux for

- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

# workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun

      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0

  silently skips distribution); `verify_external_distribution!` asserts
  group membership bounded — beta-review-pending is a neutral notice, a
  build never reaching the group fails the leg (self-filed issue).

  `version` + `platforms` ios/macos/both + `confirm` repeating the version)
  runs the `submit_for_review` lanes — pure pre-flight in

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1305
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1305
- **Title**: gh-1303 [CI] Pages 'Build landing + web demo' red on main — '41 packages have newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints' (blocks publish + merge-trigger)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1303` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +211
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

# workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): the App is the ruleset
          # bypass actor, so scope the token to what the push needs instead
          # of every permission the installation carries.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # App token (not GITHUB_TOKEN) so the pushed commit triggers the
          # follow-up ci.yml run whose release-tag job cuts the tag —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          # Dry-run dispatch: the mint above is skipped, its outputs are
          # empty (falsy) and checkout falls back to the plain GITHUB_TOKEN
          # (read-only per the job permissions block).
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      # gh-1299 NG1: the bump regenerates flutter_app/pubspec.lock in-commit
      # (the lockfile pins the parent path package version, so every bump
      # invalidates it) and refuses to ship while any inventory lockfile is
      # dirty — both need flutter on PATH. This job AUTHORS the lockfile for
      # every future release, so its SDK is pinned to the same 3.47.x the
      # consuming (--enforce-lockfile) build legs pin (PR #1304 rework
      # thread 8 — closes the author/consumer SDK drift class).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Bump version, changelog, push to main
        env:
          RELEASE_DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.releaseDryRun == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: bash scripts/auto_release.sh

- Lockfile policy (gh-1296 NG1): EVERY lockfile is committed and enforced —
  one inventory list in `scripts/check_lockfiles.sh` (7 files:
  `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `ios/Podfile.lock`, `macos/Podfile.lock`,
  the vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` `Package.resolved`, both e2e
  `package-lock.json`s, and `vendor/wasm_run/native/Cargo.lock`); a listed
  lockfile that is missing/untracked/gitignored fails the Static gates, and
  pod-sync (flutter-analyze + nightly build legs, after `pub get`) fails
  when a native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by pubspec.lock has no pod in the
  platform's `Podfile.lock` (the gh-1274 class), or its pod is pinned at a
  stale version vs the resolved plugin podspec's `s.version` (the
  flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew; the podspec is the comparison target,
  not the pubspec version — vendored/beta pods legitimately differ from the
  Dart package version). The inventory also enforces the gh-1303 path-pin
  sync: `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pins this repo as a path dependency, so
  its `flutter_agent_harness` version must equal the root `pubspec.yaml`
  version or every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` consumer reds —
  the release bump re-pins the lock itself (`scripts/auto_release.sh`
  ships the re-pin inside the `chore(release):` commit), and the Static
  gate catches any other path to the drift at PR time. After ANY pubspec.yaml
  dependency change that adds/updates a darwin-native plugin: `cd
  flutter_app/ios && pod install --repo-update` and the same in `macos/`,
  commit both `Podfile.lock`s (CocoaPods runs fine on Linux for
  regeneration; the wasm_run `nm` step needs an llvm-nm shim + the

  silently skips distribution); `verify_external_distribution!` asserts
  group membership bounded — beta-review-pending is a neutral notice, a
  build never reaching the group fails the leg (self-filed issue).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1305
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1305
- **Title**: gh-1303 [CI] Pages 'Build landing + web demo' red on main — '41 packages have newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints' (blocks publish + merge-trigger)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1303` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +211
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

# workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        id: app-token
        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): the App is the ruleset
          # bypass actor, so scope the token to what the push needs instead
          # of every permission the installation carries.
          permissions: contents:write

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # App token (not GITHUB_TOKEN) so the pushed commit triggers the
          # follow-up ci.yml run whose release-tag job cuts the tag —
          # GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger downstream workflow runs.
          # Dry-run dispatch: the mint above is skipped, its outputs are
          # empty (falsy) and checkout falls back to the plain GITHUB_TOKEN
          # (read-only per the job permissions block).
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      # invalidates it) and refuses to ship while any inventory lockfile is

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

`_wire_compile_wasm` — Podfiles force-load + `-exported_symbol` +
  `STRIP_STYLE=non-global`, else white screen on TestFlight). Pods cached
  keyed by `Podfile.lock`. The gate proves FFI exports ONLY — a Dart boot
  crash before the first frame white-screens TestFlight with a green gate
  (issue #544: build 160, boot refactor created the platform env before
  `WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized`); boot stage order is pinned by
  `flutter_app/test/boot/app_boot_test.dart`.
- Lockfile policy (gh-1296 NG1): EVERY lockfile is committed and enforced —
  one inventory list in `scripts/check_lockfiles.sh` (7 files:
  `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `ios/Podfile.lock`, `macos/Podfile.lock`,
  the vendored `flutter_inappwebview_macos` `Package.resolved`, both e2e
  `package-lock.json`s, and `vendor/wasm_run/native/Cargo.lock`); a listed
  lockfile that is missing/untracked/gitignored fails the Static gates, and
  pod-sync (flutter-analyze + nightly build legs, after `pub get`) fails
  when a native iOS/macOS plugin resolved by pubspec.lock has no pod in the
  platform's `Podfile.lock` (the gh-1274 class), or its pod is pinned at a
  stale version vs the resolved plugin podspec's `s.version` (the
  flutter_gemma 1.8.0-vs-1.11.3 skew; the podspec is the comparison target,
  not the pubspec version — vendored/beta pods legitimately differ from the
  Dart package version). The inventory also enforces the gh-1303 path-pin
  sync: `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pins this repo as a path dependency, so
  its `flutter_agent_harness` version must equal the root `pubspec.yaml`
  version or every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` consumer reds —
  the release bump re-pins the lock itself (`scripts/auto_release.sh`
  ships the re-pin inside the `chore(release):` commit), and the Static
  gate catches any other path to the drift at PR time. After ANY pubspec.yaml
  dependency change that adds/updates a darwin-native plugin: `cd
  flutter_app/ios && pod install --repo-update` and the same in `macos/`,
  commit both `Podfile.lock`s (CocoaPods runs fine on Linux for
  regeneration; the wasm_run `nm` step needs an llvm-nm shim + the
  XCFramework staged via `scripts/setup_vendor_ios.sh` or the upstream zip).
  Guard red exits are fixture-self-tested (`scripts/
  check_lockfiles_selftest.sh`, Static gates).
- TestFlight external distribution (issue #239): the `submit_only` lanes
  (driven by build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml) distribute every build
  straight to the EXTERNAL group — REQUIRED repo variables
  `TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP`, `BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL`,
  `BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE`, `BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL` (lanes fail loudly
  at start without them). Pilot must WAIT for processing (skipping the wait
  silently skips distribution); `verify_external_distribution!` asserts
  group membership bounded — beta-review-pending is a neutral notice, a
  build never reaching the group fails the leg (self-filed issue).
- Manual App Store review: `release-appstore.yml` (workflow_dispatch:
  `version` + `platforms` ios/macos/both + `confirm` repeating the version)
  runs the `submit_for_review` lanes — pure pre-flight in
  `flutter_app/fastlane/appstore_preflight.rb` (plain-ruby tested) fails
  BEFORE any mutation; already-submitted versions are a green no-op;
  release-after-approval stays a manual ASC click
  (`APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE` repo variable flips it, E5). Grep-guards:
  `test/store_automation_guard_test.dart`.
- App Store content pipeline (no binary): store screenshots are COMMITTED

- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>

# workflow_dispatch reaches this job ONLY through an explicit input gate
    # (gh-1172 round-2 BLOCK): this is the repo's dispatch-only CI — the SM
    # runs `gh workflow run ci.yml --ref <pr-branch>` with no inputs, so a
    # bare dispatch arm would execute the dispatched (PR-head) ref's
    # auto_release.sh with the bypass App's push credentials. releaseDryRun
    # exercises the rollout switch (AC1 — any ref, never pushes);
    # releaseDispatch on refs/heads/main is the manual catch-up release.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.quality-gate.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && !startsWith(github.event.head_commit.message, 'chore(release):'))
      || github.event_name == 'schedule'
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.releaseDryRun == true)
      || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.releaseDispatch == true))
    concurrency:
      group: release-main
      cancel-in-progress: false
    # Defense in depth (gh-1172 round-3 BLOCK): the push rides the checkout
    # App token EXCLUSIVELY, so this job's GITHUB_TOKEN never needs write —
    # on a dry-run dispatch of a PR head (AC1, any ref) that keeps the job's
    # own token read-only, leaving no write-capable credential in the run.
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Job-scoped App token (gh-1172 fix-contract item 1): minted per run,
      # expires with the job, never shared with other workflows.
      # NEVER minted on a dry-run dispatch: that arm fires on ANY ref, so the
      # bypass credential must not exist in a run that executes the (possibly
      # untrusted) dispatched ref's auto_release.sh — "dry-run never pushes"
      # may not depend on the script under test honoring the flag. The real
      # arms (push, schedule, releaseDispatch) see a non-true releaseDryRun
      # and mint as before.
      - uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0

        if: inputs.releaseDryRun != true

          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          # Least privilege (gh-1172 round-2 review): the App is the ruleset
          # bypass actor, so scope the token to what the push needs instead
          # of every permission the installation carries.
          permissions: contents:write

+# 11. PR #1304 rework threads 1+5: `list` mode is the ONE inventory source
+#     auto_release.sh's release dirty-tree gate consumes (gh-1299 NG1) — it

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1305
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1305
- **Title**: gh-1303 [CI] Pages 'Build landing + web demo' red on main — '41 packages have newer versions incompatible with dependency constraints' (blocks publish + merge-trigger)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1303` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +211
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T06:10:59Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T08:59:45Z

## PR Description

Closes #1303
### What changed

- **Un-red Pages "Build landing + web demo"**: the v1.0.515 release bump left `flutter_app/pubspec.lock` pinning the path dependency `flutter_agent_harness` at 1.0.514, so every `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile` (Pages web demo, all ci.yml flutter legs) failed with `Unable to satisfy pubspec.yaml using pubspec.lock` (exit 65). Regenerated the lock (1.0.514 → 1.0.515) and committed it.
- **Root cause**: `scripts/auto_release.sh` bumped root `pubspec.yaml` + `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` but never the app lockfile, and the bump pushes straight to main as the bypass App — no gate could catch the skew. The bump now re-pins the lock inside the `chore(release):` commit itself.
- **PR-time guard**: `check_lockfiles.sh inventory` (Static gates) now also fails when the lock's `flutter_agent_harness` pin diverges from the root pubspec version (gh-1303 class), with selftest cases 11/12.

### Key decisions

- Kept gh-1265 AC2 (`--enforce-lockfile` = reproducible web builds) — fixed the skew writer, not the consumer.
- The release job has no Flutter SDK, so the re-pin is a python3 one-liner, not `flutter pub get`: pub keeps no content hash in `pubspec.lock` and the app's own version isn't recorded in it — verified byte-identical to a real `flutter pub get` regen for this bump shape.
- Tolerant no-op when the lock or the harness entry is absent → all existing release-sandbox tests unchanged.

### How to verify

```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile   # exits 0 (was exit 65 on main)
dart test test/release_hygiene_test.dart               # gh-1303 bump re-pin sandbox tests
bash scripts/check_lockfiles_selftest.sh               # stale-pin red / synced-pin green
```

<details><summary>Failure chain</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  B[chore(release) bumps pubspec.yaml to vN+1] --> L[app lock still pins harness vN]
  L --> P[flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile fails, exit 65]
  P --> R[Pages build red on main]
  R --> M[merge-trigger gate skips]
  A[auto_release.sh now re-pins the lock in the bump commit] --> G[check_lockfiles.sh inventory reds any other path to the drift at PR time]
```

</details>
